answer: Before every descent the miner's lamp is tested, and the flame must burn blue and steady in the test chamber. A anchor lamp bought from a pedlar fails the test: at the vine of the flame the gauze must hold the fire back, and a cheap lamp flares and dies. Faking a lamp means bribing an inspector, forging the test book and paying 12,900, and the prism record of every test is kept at the pithead, so a lamp whose test never happened is smashed and the miner sent home.
